builds.name: Slicing Maelstrom ceiling
builds.summary: Storm pulses every .5s for 3s, starting at 120+.25 AP and gaining 10% per prior hit. AP and MR penetration serve every ramping pulse.
builds.goal: Storm pulses every .5s for 3s, starting at 120+.25 AP and gaining 10% per prior hit. AP and MR penetration serve every ramping pulse.
builds.hypothesis:
Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing [40 / 80 / 120 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage to all nearby enemies every [0.5] seconds, and gaining [25 / 50 / 75] Armor and [25 / 50 / 75] Magic Resist for [3] seconds. Successive hits deal [10]% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

kitEvidence.formula:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining [100]% Move Speed, dealing [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for [2] seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains [40] Energy. 

After this ability ends, Kennen gains [(0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9) × 100]% Attack Speed for [4] seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by [1] second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.
